name: com.neoxider.tools
description: Production-ready Unity tools and gameplay modules for rapid development, with no-code components, samples, and module documentation.

samples.description: Module demos and integration scenes. Import NeoxiderPages and Character Movement Fundamentals too when using the legacy cross-module integration scenes.
Optional page-navigation sample module with PM, UIPage, BtnChangePage, and UIKit helpers.

Demo scenes for the 3D character controller: slopes, stairs, moving platforms, gravity tunnels and a top-down arena, with the environment art they use. Optional — the character presets ship self-contained.
